summary: Housatonic Partners, a San Francisco-based growth private equity firm, announced a strategic growth investment in eCard Systems on December 15, 2023 (financial terms undisclosed) to fund expansion of sales, marketing, technology, and production capabilities. eCard is led by CEO Benjamin Berg, a search-fund entrepreneur who acquired the company in 2017 with backing from an investor group that included Housatonic.

eCard Systems, headquartered in Brentwood, TN, is described in the Housatonic release as an end-to-end provider of outsourced gift card programs and processing for more than 100,000 restaurants, retail stores, salons/spas, and other small-to-medium businesses; the company's own marketing separately states it serves 'over 140 brands and thousands of merchants' with integration into 125+ POS systems. (Scope note: The '100,000+ restaurants/retailers' figure (investor release) and '140 brands' figure (vendor site) appear to measure different things (individual merchant locations vs. branded enterprise accounts) and should not be treated as reconciled.)
eCard Systems is the official partner supplying physical Toast Gift Cards for merchants on the Toast POS platform.
